g.title: CACS_QSP
g.text: Cancer Anorexia-Cachexia Syndrome — Quantitative Systems Pharmacology Map
tumour cachexins → (A) anorexia via GFRAL/melanocortin + (B) catabolism via STAT3/SMAD-FoxO + (C) loss of muscle QUALITY → mass, function and survival dissociate
19 mechanistic modules · 247 nodes · 457 edges · states carried as ODEs in cacs_mrgsolve_model.R are drawn with a double border

g.title: cluster_tumor
g.text: 1. 종양 구획 · 종양 유래 카켁신 (Tumour compartment & tumour-derived cachexins)

g.title: cluster_infl
g.text: 2. 전신 염증 · 순환 매개체 풀 (Systemic inflammation — circulating mediator pool)

g.title: cluster_liver
g.text: 3. 간 급성기 반응 · 대사 재프로그래밍 (Hepatic acute-phase response & metabolic reprogramming)

g.title: cluster_brainstem
g.text: 4. [팔 A-i] 뇌간 GFRAL · 최후영역 (ARM A-i: brainstem GFRAL / area postrema)

g.title: cluster_hypo
g.text: 5. [팔 A-ii] 시상하부 멜라노코르틴 (ARM A-ii: hypothalamic melanocortin system)

g.title: cluster_prote
g.text: 7. [팔 B-i] 골격근 단백 이화 (ARM B-i: skeletal muscle proteolysis)

g.title: cluster_anab
g.text: 8. [팔 B-ii] 동화 신호 · 동화 저항 (ARM B-ii: anabolic signalling & anabolic resistance)

g.title: cluster_fat
g.text: 9. 지방조직 · 지방분해 및 갈색화 (Adipose tissue: lipolysis & browning)

g.title: cluster_body
g.text: 12. 체성분 · 장기 결과 (Body composition & organ-level consequences)

g.title: cluster_func
g.text: 13. [축 C] 근육의 질 · 신체 기능 (AXIS C: muscle QUALITY & physical function) — the axis that mass-only drugs miss

g.title: cluster_pd
g.text: 16. 약물 · 표적 (Drugs and their molecular targets) — placed by WHICH ARM THEY CUT

g.title: cluster_onc
g.text: 18. 항암치료 — 원인이자 치료 (Anticancer therapy: both aggravator and definitive cure)

g.title: cluster_end
g.text: 19. 병기 · 임상 엔드포인트 (Fearon staging & clinical endpoints)

g.title: TU_BURD
g.text: Gompertz growth · TVOL0 x exp(ln(TMAX/TVOL0)(1-e^-kg t))
the single upstream driver of the whole map

g.title: TU_LIF
g.text: gp130 ligand, potent in murine C26

g.title: TU_PIF
g.text: controversial in humans - drawn as hypothesis

g.title: EN_REE
g.text: RISES while intake falls - the defining paradox

g.title: IM_MAC
g.text: M1 skew · amplify IL-6 and TNF

g.title: IM_GDF15S
g.text: strongest single predictor of weight loss

g.title: MU_FN14
g.text: TWEAK receptor, appears only in atrophying muscle

g.title: AN_GHR
g.text: Hepatic GH resistance (SOCS3 up, GHR down)
GH rises but IGF-1 does not follow

g.title: AD_ATGL
g.text: ATGL-null mice are protected from cachexia

g.title: FN_PGC1
g.text: collapses early, before mass is lost

g.title: PK_CPLX
g.text: total GDF-15 rises, FREE GDF-15 collapses

g.title: MU_ACTRIIB
g.text: shared by activin A, myostatin, GDF-11

g.title: IM_MSTN
g.text: (muscle is the source; less muscle = less myostatin)

g.title: LV_MASS
g.text: liver mass RISES while muscle falls

g.title: LV_APRAA
g.text: ~ 2.6 g muscle protein per 1 g fibrinogen

g.title: BC_EDEMA
g.text: MASKS true tissue loss on the scale

g.title: EN_CORI
g.text: 6 ATP consumed per 2 ATP the tumour gains

g.title: BS_PBN
g.text: final common path for aversive anorexia

g.title: HY_PVN
g.text: integrates to feeding + CRH + sympathetic output

g.title: BS_CTA
g.text: food becomes a learned aversive cue

g.title: HY_AGRP
g.text: SHOULD fire when fat mass falls

g.title: HY_LEP
g.text: the rescue signal that FAILS to rescue

g.title: HY_GHRE
g.text: yet appetite does not - ghrelin resistance

g.title: AN_ARES
g.text: the fraction of a protein bolus that is WASTED
WHY FOOD ALONE DOES NOT WORK

g.title: AN_AKT
g.text: node where anabolism and FoxO meet

g.title: AD_FAT
g.text: LOST BEFORE MUSCLE - the earliest signal

g.title: AD_LEPS
g.text: Leptin secretion falls with fat mass

g.title: AD_FIBR
g.text: limits refilling even after tumour control

g.title: EN_FUT
g.text: Other futile cycles: triglyceride-FFA, protein turnover

g.title: FN_MYOQ
g.text: driven DOWN by inflammation, UP by loading,

g.title: EN_AEE
g.text: falls with ECOG - partly offsets REE rise

g.title: NE_CORT
g.text: loss of diurnal rhythm, relative excess

g.title: FN_DIL
g.text: QUALITY DILUTION of newly added mass
mass added faster than mitochondria are built

g.title: ON_TOXG
g.text: rises with low SMI (dose per kg lean, not per m2)

g.title: FN_ATP
g.text: ATP supply per gram of muscle

g.title: ON_STOP
g.text: the commonest proximate cause of death

g.title: EP_QOL
g.text: EORTC QLQ-C30 global health / physical function

g.title: PK_ANAD
g.text: 100 mg PO qd, fasted; Tmax ~1 h

g.title: PK_TCZC
g.text: TMDD: CL falls as IL-6R saturates

g.title: NP_RES
g.text: the ONLY intervention that raises QUALITY

g.title: NP_PROT
g.text: 25-30 g with >= 2.5 g leucine per meal

g.title: NP_PSY
g.text: Psychosocial support for patient AND family

g.title: LEG
g.text: the amino-acid vicious cycle (muscle feeds the tumour)
Axis C — quality dilution of rapidly added mass
